hero.name: Benedictus Richard Ricardo
hero.lead: I make messy operations run clean.
hero.body: This portfolio is laid out like a case board — because that's kind of how I work. Find what's broken, figure out the pattern, build something that holds, then check if it actually worked.

profile.title: Profile Dossier
profile.summary: I tend to land in situations where nobody's quite sure who owns what, the process is a mess, and things keep slipping through. My job is usually part detective, part builder.
profile.philosophy: If a system feels complicated to use, it's not done yet. The goal is making the next step obvious — so people stop guessing and start moving.
profile.note: I'm also studying Data Science at Universitas Terbuka. It changes how I look at process problems — more evidence, less gut feeling.

facts.label: Primary value
facts.value: Turning repeated friction into dependable routine

capabilityClusters.title: Systems Architecture
capabilityClusters.summary: Figuring out how things should flow, where handoffs break, and what needs to be tracked to keep it all running.

capabilityClusters.title: Workflow Automation
capabilityClusters.summary: Getting rid of the copy-paste-reformat cycle and replacing it with something that runs on its own.

capabilityClusters.title: Governance & Leadership
capabilityClusters.summary: Giving teams a cadence — regular check-ins, clear expectations, and a way to see who's doing what.

capabilityClusters.title: Live Operations
capabilityClusters.summary: Keeping things on track when the audience is watching and there's no room to wing it.

capabilityClusters.title: Training & Readiness
capabilityClusters.summary: Making sure gear is ready, drills are run, and people know what to do before the situation demands it.

contact.title: Open to talking about systems, automation, and ops work.
contact.body: Best fit for teams or roles that need things to run cleaner, more reliably, or with less manual overhead. Based in GMT+7.
contact.availability: Happy to chat across GMT+7 and nearby time zones.
